banner.subtitle: Add to your home screen or desktop for quick access.
banner.title: Install LettMat
banner.firefox_desktop_subtitle: Firefox on desktop does not natively support installing web apps. Bookmark LettMat or open it in Chrome or Edge to install.

guide.ios_step1: Tap the Share button in your browser toolbar.
guide.ios_step2: Select "Add to Home Screen" and tap Add.
guide.safari_step1: Click the Share button in Safari (or File in the menu bar).
guide.firefox_android_step1: Tap the menu button (three dots) in Firefox.
guide.firefox_android_step2: Choose "Install" or "Add to Home screen" and confirm.
guide.firefox_desktop_subtitle: Firefox on desktop does not natively support Progressive Web App installation. You can still get quick access to LettMat:
guide.firefox_desktop_step1: Bookmark this page (Ctrl+D or Cmd+D) or pin the tab in Firefox for one-click access.
guide.firefox_desktop_step2: To install LettMat as a standalone desktop app, open it in Chrome, Edge, or Brave, or use a Firefox web-app extension.
guide.standard_step1: Click the install icon in the address bar or open the browser menu.
guide.standard_step2: Choose "Install LettMat" or "Add to Home screen".
guide.subtitle: Install LettMat as an app for a full-screen experience and instant access.
